objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix assigned to the document (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: System-assigned sequential number appended to the document abbreviation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tracking the revision history of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period for validity review cycle, default is 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period for archived documents before physical deletion, default is 10 years.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope(s) defining the applicability or coverage area of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related master data or other documents maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document via its properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies relevant to or associated with the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas or regions where the document is applicable.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the primary author of the document, automatically set to the creator but changeable.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned personal change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: User groups and persons on the distribution list who receive email notification upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups and persons on the distribution list who must actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original Office format (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) in which the document content is authored.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The original language of the document content.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification category defining the level and kind of a document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction), with configurable templates, abbreviation, validity period, and archive duration.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the document type (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid to which this document type belongs.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Language-independent abbreviation code used in document numbering (e.g. RL).

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: Default period for validity extension checks defined for this document type.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: Default archiving retention period defined for this document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name or title of the document template.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: The MS Office format of the template (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the release of the main document. Creation, modification, or archiving triggers a new version of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment, tracked independently but following the main document's release process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment aligned with the main document's release statuses.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object attached to a document that is not subject to a release cycle and can be published directly via property switches. Its creation, modification, or deletion does not affect the main document's version.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name or title of the additional information item.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Switch indicating whether the additional info is released and published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changes to an existing released document, managed in the document's cockpit. It does not affect the document's content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description of the proposed change to the document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expiration date, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a document that no longer has validity, triggering the archiving process with workflow support.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its original metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments. Only the Business Admin group may create it.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users defined in the system for assigning read, change, or acknowledgement authorizations to documents (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Role type of the group (e.g. reader, author, reviewer, releaser, archive, business admin).

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who can be assigned roles and authorizations for document management activities.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which the user logs into the system, affecting which translated document versions are displayed.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature recorded by a workflow participant during the release process, documented per released version for traceability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was applied.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The workflow step (Creator, Review, or Release) at which the signature was provided.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list maintained per document specifying user groups and individual persons who should receive the document via email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution entry: by email notification or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A record of a user's active confirmation that they have read and noted a released document version, tracked with workflow support.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

attributes.name: user
attributes.description: The person who confirmed or is expected to confirm the acknowledgement.

attributes.name: document_version
attributes.description: The version of the document for which the acknowledgement is requested.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity in the system that can be linked to documents for process-specific or location-specific structuring.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the organizational unit.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process modeled in the system that can be linked to documents, enabling process-specific filing and referencing.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the business process.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object in the system that can be linked to documents for governance and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name or title of the risk.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application registered as master data in the system that can be referenced by documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the IT application.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be configured per document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the client.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-specific version of a released document that must go through its own review and release workflow before becoming visible to readers in the corresponding language.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The target language of the translation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the translated version (e.g. in progress, released).

attributes.name: reviewer_translation
attributes.description: Person assigned to review the translated content.

attributes.name: releaser_translation
attributes.description: Person assigned to release the translated content.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and optionally a template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during document creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The document template selected during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and properties of a document are maintained or updated by the author or co-author.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step (Creator) with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and formal correctness and completes the review step with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the review was approved or rejected.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document with an electronic signature, making it visible to addressed readers.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the release was approved or rejected.

evts.name: reject_during_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_during_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to the addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining all data from the previous version.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: What triggered the new version (e.g. content change, attachment change, change proposal scheduling).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: A supplementary additional information object is added to a document without affecting the document's version.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is modified without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is released and published directly via property switches.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by an employee with author rights, without affecting the document's content or version history.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description of the proposed change.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of an assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's validity expiration date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension_by_releaser
evts.description: The releaser processes the validity extension request, deciding to extend validity, revise, or invalidate the document.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Decision outcome: extend validity, revise, or invalidate.

evts.name: process_validity_extension_by_author
evts.description: The author processes a validity extension as part of the author-reviewer-releaser workflow variant.

evts.name: process_validity_extension_review
evts.description: The reviewer processes the validity extension check as part of the author-reviewer-releaser workflow variant.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of the document is extended, updating the Valid Until date by the default period and deleting the validity extension request.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and start the override workflow.

evts.name: process_override_by_releaser
evts.description: The releaser processes the override request, declaring the document out of force.

evts.name: process_override_by_initiator
evts.description: The initiator of the override request checks the request and the document in the first step of the 3-step override workflow.

evts.name: process_override_review
evts.description: The reviewer processes the override request review step.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document's last valid version is set to Out of Force status, existing edited versions are deleted, and all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: After the override declaration, the document and its attachments are archived with revocation of all authorizations except the archive group.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived documents are physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator of the reactivation request confirms the reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments.

evts.name: send_distribution_by_email
evts.description: Upon release of a new document version, email notifications are sent to all users and user groups on the distribution-by-info list.

evts.name: send_acknowledgement_request
evts.description: Upon release of a new document version, acknowledgement requests are sent by email to all users and user groups on the distribution-for-acknowledgement list.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via the workflow task.

evts.name: initiate_translation
evts.description: A translation of a released document into another language is initiated.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The target language for the translation.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: A reviewer checks the translated content for correctness with workflow support.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the translation review was approved or rejected.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the translated document version, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the translation release was approved or rejected.

evts.name: assign_reader_authorization
evts.description: A user group is assigned as reader for a document, granting read access to all users in the group.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: A user is assigned as author or co-author on a document, granting read and write permissions.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: A user is assigned as reviewer on a document, granting read and write permissions.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: A user is assigned as releaser on a document, granting read and write permissions.

o2o.description: Each document belongs to one document type that defines its level, abbreviation, validity period, and archive duration.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type for use when creating new documents.
A document can have one or more controlled attachments that follow its release cycle.
A document can have one or more additional information objects that are not subject to the release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to exactly one document and is managed in its cockpit.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
A request for override is linked to the document to be invalidated.
A request for reactivation references the archived document to be reactivated.
Each document has a distribution list specifying user groups and persons for notification or acknowledgement.
A distribution list entry can reference a user group whose members receive the document.
A distribution list entry can reference an individual user for direct notification or acknowledgement.
A released document can have one or more translations into different languages.
A document can be linked to one or more business processes for process-specific filing.
A document can be linked to one or more organizational units for location-specific structuring.
A document can be linked to one or more risks for governance and compliance purposes.
A document can reference one or more IT applications via its properties.
A document can reference other documents via the references attribute.
In a multi-client system, a document can be configured for visibility in specific clients.
Users are assigned to user groups, which determine their roles and authorizations in the system.
Each released version of a document has electronic signatures documented from workflow participants.
Acknowledgements are tracked per document version for users on the distribution-for-acknowledgement list.
